What if you breathed through your mouth all night?
Your body is built to breathe through your nose, day and night. You'd wake up with a dry mouth. A stuffy nose or allergies are often the reason.

But here's the twist. Your nose filters, warms and moistens the air, so mouth breathing can lead to bad breath, cavities and snoring! It can also make sleep apnea worse, so a blocked nose is worth checking.
